acquisition_method.evidence: MS data were recorded by data dependent acquisition.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Reduced thiols were alkylated with 40 mM chloroacetamid and samples were diluted with 25 mM Tris/HCl, pH 8.5, 10% acetonitrile to obtain a final GdmCl concentration of 0.6 M.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Reduced thiols were alkylated with 40 mM chloroacetamid and samples were diluted with 25 mM Tris/HCl, pH 8.5, 10% acetonitrile to obtain a final GdmCl concentration of 0.6 M.

cleavage_agent.evidence: 100 µg of protein was digested with 1 µg trypsin (sequencing grade, Promega) overnight at 37°C under gentle agitation.

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptides were fractionated on multi-stop-and-go tips (StageTips) containing C18-tips and strong cation exchange (SCX) tips.

ptm.evidence: carbamidomethylation (+57.02) on cysteines was set as fixed modification
Acetylation of N-terminus (+42.01) and oxidation of methionine (+15.99) were selected for variable modification
Acetylation of N-terminus (+42.01) and oxidation of methionine (+15.99) were selected for variable modification

reduction_concentration.evidence: All pellets were resolved in 6 M Guanidinhydrochlorid (GdmCl), 100 mM Tris/HCl, pH 8.5, 10 mM TCEP and incubated at 95°C for 5 min.

reduction_reagent.evidence: All pellets were resolved in 6 M Guanidinhydrochlorid (GdmCl), 100 mM Tris/HCl, pH 8.5, 10 mM TCEP and incubated at 95°C for 5 min.
